The '''raid on the Skar'kla Consortium''' took place prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the criminal organization known as the [[Skar'kla Consortium]] and forces hired by a rival [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal. The Hutt hired an [[Unidentified Hutt enforcer|enforcer]] to disguise himself as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Consortium's leader, [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Akris Ur'etu]].

==The raid==
Akris surrounded himself with thugs and hired the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to defend him. However the imposter tracked down Akris who fled with six thugs into an Akris base. The Jedi imposter pursued them and killed the thugs while the Bothan escaped further into the compound where he meet up with his [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Unidentified Weequay security chief|security chief]]. The imposter then killed them both while Bane arrived. Bane then battled the imposter and defeated him despite his advanced equipment, however the bounty hunter let him live on the condition that the enforcer showed the Duros how to make his equipment and allowed him to claim Akris's bounty.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The raid on the Skar'kla Consortium first appeared in the short story ''[[Reputation (Cad Bane)|Reputation]]'', written by [[Ari Marmell]] and illustrated by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]], which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 136|''Star Wars Insider'' 136]] in [[2012]].
